summary: Broad oversold capitulation led by oil & gas. Headline divergence: Brent crude rose 2.71% to $91.41 while the VN oil & gas sector fell -6.05% in a single session — the worst sector by a 2x margin. All 6 flagged tickers print RSI oversold and 0/4 bullish indicators. Volume separates two distinct regimes: GAS (4.0x avg), DIG (1.9x) and BSR/PLX (~1.5x) show capitulation on heavy turnover, whereas GEX (0.87x) and FPT (0.98x) are grinding declines on average-or-below volume — a weaker, more persistent pattern. No impact-chain corroboration was available this cycle (get_open_chain_findings returned only system-auditor rows), so the crude-vs-equity divergence is recorded as an observation, not a validated causal chain.
